policy: No work package is production-active merely because its dependency-light prototype compiles. Promotion requires an explicit production call site and the evidence level named by its gate.

accepted_supporting_changes.reason: Both applications require one unambiguous arc-length-versus-volume measure vocabulary before any Parker geometric-drift option can be promoted.
The active event-driven mover must preserve the actual branch and immediate pre/post wave-frame momenta; shell endpoints include unrelated deterministic work.

work_packages.reason: The store and restart format are controlled-tested, but the active AMPS adapter still uses host wave arrays as its runtime owner.
work_packages.promotion_gate: Replace the host-array lifecycle transactionally and pass configured AMPS restart equivalence.

work_packages.reason: Atomic batch logic is a prototype. Only branch-local event metadata is accepted in the active mover; production still uses the established queue/flush adapter.
work_packages.promotion_gate: Wire one drain-and-commit path and close particle plus wave energy in native AMPS and MPI runs.

work_packages.reason: The tensor contraction is verified, but the present host does not provide the complete three-dimensional velocity gradient at this seam.
work_packages.promotion_gate: Add a provider-owned full gradient and validate divergence, strain, curvature, and continuity residuals natively.
